steps.title: Start a new Scratch project
steps.instruction: Open Scratch and click Create. You should see the Stage and a sprite (cat).
steps.hint: If you can’t see the cat, refresh Scratch.
steps.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
say [Hello!] for (2) seconds

steps.title: Ask the player’s name
steps.instruction: Use Sensing → ask and wait, then say hello using join and answer.
steps.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
ask [What is your name?] and wait
say (join [Hello ] (answer)) for (2) seconds

steps.title: Add a friendly ending
steps.instruction: Add one more say block: “Nice to meet you!” after the hello.
steps.hint: Put the new say block AFTER the join line.
steps.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
ask [What is your name?] and wait
say (join [Hello ] (answer)) for (2) seconds
say [Nice to meet you!] for (2) seconds
